claims.text: The generalization ability of NCEL is verified by evaluating it on five different benchmarks, demonstrating consistent performance across datasets.
NCEL shows good generalization ability as it consistently outperforms various baselines on multiple datasets, indicating robustness across different conditions.
The model's generalization ability is further supported by its performance on challenging datasets, where it maintains effectiveness despite noise.
